summary: Discussion-first pulse: operator pain with MCP and agent sandboxes, security incidents and vendor content controls (Anthropic/DeepSeek), plus tooling breakthroughs for MCP/context-window and GitOps agent integration. | Vendor updates: VS Code extension supply-chain alert, multiple MCP/mem0 GHSA security advisories, major vendor product launches (AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Cursor Agent SDK/rollouts, Cloudflare private origins, Daytona updates), and operator playbooks for agent runtimes and FinOps. | New agent development tools and frameworks are emerging, focusing on enhanced computer use, multi-agent orchestration, and improved sandboxing for security. Releases from Google Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, and Microsoft Agent Framework indicate ongoing platform development. Several projects are exploring novel approaches to agent interaction with the operating system and local environments. | Package-snapshot: several mainstream vendor packages (OpenAI, Vercel, AWS) plus many new/updated infra primitives for agent runtimes, MCP/browser bridging, sandboxes and security scanners; no social/operator reports present.
